knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The manual states that steam cleaning must wait for completed training and a tested competency.
Eye protection and protective gloves are required throughout a steam job.
The electrical connection and the possibility of triggering fire or smoke detectors are both reasons for these precautions.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the set-up of a steam unit: glasses and gloves on, cable checked, warning sign placed; pass when all four are in place before switch-on
Learner states, from a sample scenario, the condition that stops the job, with the correct condition given
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor sign-off of practical set-up, separate from the quiz
stopWorkCriteria: No training or competency record for the operator
Electrical equipment or uncovered sockets are in the work area
